status: Proposed for discussion; not approved or implemented
direction: Futuristic Roblox stud UI with rich plum, grape and teal surfaces; restrained amber actions and clear light/dark contrast

roles.base: Deep plum menu backplates and recessed areas
roles.panel: Grape item cards and structural panels; all peers share a surface
roles.header: Teal title bars and navigation chrome
roles.selection: Mint selected outlines and active labels; pair with labels or markers
roles.primaryAction: Amber Equip, View Ball and equivalent primary actions; keep area small
roles.featured: Use existing grape surfaces with a small amber label; do not add another accent hue
roles.text: Warm ivory primary text; light lavender secondary copy
roles.success: Soft green equipped state and confirmation

display.use: Game wordmark, screen titles and major headings

treatments: Square corners, crisp dark outlines and narrow light inner edges
Visible separation of plum backplates, grape cards and teal title bars
Fine embossed square studs on structural surfaces
Opaque backing behind header text keeps stud highlights away from small copy
Mint selection lines and short geometric details; no broad neon glow
Colorful canonical ball artwork on consistent peer cards
scope: Visual direction proposal only; no runtime source edits, new gameplay or benchmark implementation
gameplay: Keep existing cyan/coral team identities and territory meaning; do not recolor gameplay by cosmetic palette.
pending: Updated complete Inventory and Store mockups in the agreed scheme
Frozen benchmark target and acceptance scope
preview: Revised inline theme board with canonical artwork and local select/equip interaction. Older palette board retained. Not a complete web-first benchmark.
browserQA: Static markup and JavaScript review only. Browser visual inspection was unavailable because the browser URL policy disallowed file URLs.
contrastMethod: Calculated sRGB relative-luminance ratios for default solid foreground/background pairs; does not certify rendered or game UI accessibility
